title: Plasma N-glycomes of ASGR1- and MRC1-deficient mice under dietary challenge
description: Seventy-two sialic-linkage-resolved plasma N-glycan features across 46 MALDI-TOF-MS observations from a study of hepatic and macrophage glycan-receptor deficiency. Observations include experimental animals and pooled controls.
details: The complete author-renormalized matrix is retained as fractions, with its individual acquisition filenames as observation identifiers. Genotype, diet, sex, sample ID and source group are joined by exact acquisition filename. Pooled controls remain explicitly identified; the source metadata are not reinterpreted as independent animals. Neu5Ac/Neu5Gc linkage-specific derivatization and O-acetylated species are preserved. No additional normalization or imputation is performed.
annotation: H and N encode Hex and HexNAc; F encodes Fuc. Ge/Gl encode alpha2,6/alpha2,3-linked Neu5Gc, E/L encode the corresponding Neu5Ac linkages, and Ac denotes an acetyl substituent. Linkage counts remain in source annotations; composition does not imply a full structure.
